template.name: Shelly Plug S Gen 1
template.description: Template for Shelly Plug S Gen 1. Data from device will read via HTTP request.

item.name: Shelly Device Info
item.description: This is the master Item that request the Shelly Plug S (gen 1) device info via http request.This is static device info, so very slow update interval and small storage period. The exact values will be stored for a longer period via the dependend items. In my case http auth only works with digest, but this may depend on FW version.

item.name: Shelly Device Status
item.description: This is the master Item that request the Shelly Plug S (gen 1) device status via http request. We update this field fast (every 1m, but keep the data only 1h) The exact values will be stored for a longer period via the dependend items. In my case http auth only works with digest, but this may depend on FW version.

trigger.name: Offline
trigger.description: No status updates received from the device for 3 minutes; the device may be offline.

macro.description: the password used to access the shelly plug switch via http. if no pwd set leave blank
the username used to access the shelly plug switch via http. If you have no password set leave blank, otherwise "admin" is default
